scope: Only T148 delta against the captured dirty-worktree baseline; final released backend, AI, frontend and root scripts. No source, docs, thesis or frozen experiment writes.

verified_mechanisms.conclusion: Project write authorization precedes generation. Configured external-provider path invokes the sensitive-data guard before the transaction/provider call; keyless rule mode remains possible. Full-input audit access still requires project management and unblinded access.

verified_mechanisms.area: Blueprint relation contract and current input
verified_mechanisms.conclusion: Edges resolve only typed node IDs admitted in the same batch; cross-type label ambiguity rejects the edge. Edge source_kind matches the actual parser path. Note input uses the note current_version_id with note_id scope, fixed fields and content.

Node, active edge and open-alert writes use the existing partial unique indexes with ON CONFLICT. Better source priority can update one existing node, duplicate edges are counted only when inserted, acknowledged alert history does not replace the open-alert conflict target.

Blueprint audit retains full/sent input, SHA-256, source IDs/version, truncation and generation parameters; provider response identity survives parse fallback. Extraction run audit and extracted field relations share current note version, scope, input hash and rule version in one transaction. Structured array elements preserve punctuation and stay atomic while scalar/body supplements retain their existing rules.

Exact unrounded values, threshold/enabled state, latest-ten approval ordering, numerator/denominator, source approval IDs/versions and blueprint support are retained using the database evaluation timestamp, in the same evaluation transaction.

Provider connect and full-response body timeouts are bounded. The 300-second project RAG rebuild budget propagates failure through confirmed-tool execution before the approving transaction commits, preserving old chunks and preventing success/idempotency writes on failure. Manual single-file failure rolls back before recording failure state.

verified_mechanisms.area: SSE string IDs, replay and action binding
verified_mechanisms.conclusion: Raw SSE IDs remain strings, nonempty repeated IDs are ignored within the active session, native connection errors do not overwrite a terminal server MessageEvent, and completion/rejection updates only waiting confirmations with the exact pending action ID. Permission/expiry/deep-plan conflicts cause no automatic write retry.

verified_mechanisms.area: Load/soak evidence and backup guard test isolation
verified_mechanisms.conclusion: Every attempted request retains method/path, payload hash, server request ID, latency and failure result. Percentiles use raw attempts; throughput scope includes login; soak distinguishes requested duration from actual elapsed duration and raw pooled p95 from a legacy max-cycle fallback. fakeGit is confined to the subprocess fixture and does not change production restore.

Canonical facts and common documents are fixed independently of reference answers; full-fact encoding comparison and estimated-token-cap ordering comparison are separate. Exclusive outputs, frozen input checks, question-level pairing and persisted failures prevent selective overwriting. Existing 48/48 batch and negative point estimates remain intact; no new generation or reanalysis performed.

frontend.database_write_evidence: Mock counters only; Rust integration evidence covers backend authorization and atomicity.

validation_evidence.root_image_and_full_system_acceptance: Parent agent owns acceptance; this static review does not certify a deployed image or claim system E2E completion.

nonblocking_limits.statement: Native EventSource inherits the previous lastEventId if an id line is omitted. Empty-ID preservation is verified for an explicit empty id: reset (or an initially empty cursor), not every message that omits id. Current backend durable and legacy events all emit IDs, so this is a claim boundary rather than a defect in the current producer contract.

Deduplication lives in component session memory; refresh durability is not claimed. Exact action-ID trajectory binding is verified, while mock API counters do not establish backend writes and the multi-action case does not establish a complete multi-pending workflow.

ON CONFLICT establishes the tested same-key uniqueness/update behavior under current PostgreSQL isolation. Arbitrary overlapping batches with reversed key acquisition, concurrent retire/restore and alternative isolation levels are outside this evidence.
The total 300-second budget covers the project RAG rebuild phase; it does not establish an end-to-end deadline for a combined RAG-plus-graph action or the whole Agent turn.

This is a retrospective development control on 12 previously used public GEO questions, one run, scored by lexical aliases. The encoding comparison changes token length; budget comparison shares an offline message-content cap rather than equal API-consumed tokens. API token counts differ from estimates. Current point estimates are negative and do not support independent graph-topology benefit, semantic correctness, held-out generalization or repeatability.

Load/soak retain failed attempts and actual duration, but a soak can exceed its target while the final cycle finishes. Input/version/hash auditing records exact observed inputs and rule versions; it does not promise deterministic reproduction of an external model response.
